messages:
maria (eng-ml): Heads-up: nightly-eval flagged a regression in generation quality for the new quant build (packed-token-fusion). Score delta on promptset 'dev-code-snippets' jumped +14% token overlap / early termination. Samples attached below.

cheng (eng-ml): yikes, any obvious diff in the tokenization or KV outputs?

maria (eng-ml): quick summary:
- failing model: redwood-open-3b, quant variant q2-packed-fuse (build: 2026-06-02 / commit 9b3f2d)
- baseline: q2-packed (no-fuse) stable overnight
- metric: promptset token-stability (overlap/duplication +14%), stopseq early termination +7% on this set
- top failure mode: duplicated token runs and collapsed code block boundaries, e.g. triple-backtick blocks getting merged into single-line chunks

alex (eng-ml): can you paste a couple of raw samples?

maria (eng-ml): pasted below (original prompt + output):

Prompt: "Write a python function that reverses a linked list:
```python
def reverse_list(head):"

Baseline (q2-packed):
"""def reverse_list(head):
    prev = None
    curr = head
    while curr:
        nxt = curr.next
        curr.next = prev
        prev = curr
        curr = nxt
    return prev
"""

q2-packed-fuse output (regression):
"""def reverse_list(head):prev=Nonecurr=headwhilecurr:nxt=curr.nextcurr.next=prevprev=currcurr=nxtreturnprev"""

(every newline removed inside codeblocks; also seen duplicated 'returnprevreturnprev' in other prompts)

eva (eng-ml): that looks like tokenization/fusion collapsed whitespace/newlines. Could be a change in the token-fusion step that removes the delimiter tokens between subword merges.

maria (eng-ml): agree. I diffed the tokenizer logs between runs and found that the packed-fuse tokenizer module (pack_fuse_v2) changed the joiner token behavior in commit 9b3f2d. The commit message: "improve packing by merging adjacent subtoken joins".

cheng (eng-ml): do we have a reproducer with raw token ids?

maria (eng-ml): yes, cooked a small trace for the failing prompt.

Token ids (baseline): [101, 245, 13, 102, 300, 999, 3, 17]
Token ids (fuse):     [101, 245, 13, 102, 300, 999, 17]  <-- missing delimiter token 3

maria (eng-ml): So the fuse pass is dropping a delimiter token when two subtokens are merged across a newline boundary. That explains missing newlines and duplicated concatenations (later passes reconstruct boundaries incorrectly).

sam (eng-infra): timeline? was this rolled into the nightly pipeline recently?

maria (eng-ml): yes, pack_fuse_v2 was enabled in the quant build on 2026-06-02 and gated by a perf check only (latency/cost), not by nightly quality thresholds.

deploy-bot: pack_fuse_v2 was merged to main @ 2026-06-02T03:14:22Z (PR #4129).

monitoring-bot: nightly-eval failure alert: 1766000010 — token-stability metric exceeded threshold for redwood-open-3b q2-packed-fuse.

alex (eng-ml): root cause hypothesis: pack_fuse_v2 merges subtokens across newline joiners, dropping the explicit delimiter token that downstream reconstruction expects. Fix should either preserve delimiter tokens or change reconstruction to treat fused-subtokens with implicit delimiters.

cheng (eng-ml): mitigation plan (short-term): rollback packing to pre-fuse variant for hosted/nightly, pin model to q2-packed (no-fuse) and block further rollout until we have a quality gating rule.

maria (eng-ml): agreed. Proposed immediate actions:
1) Pin production and nightly jobs to q2-packed (previous stable build 9a7d11) for redwood-open-3b. Command we ran:
```bash
# pin model variant for nightly runs
./infra/tools/model-pin --model redwood-open-3b --variant q2-packed --until 2026-06-07
```
2) Disable pack_fuse_v2 in the quant pipeline and revert PR #4129 in staging.
```bash
# quick revert (staging)
git revert 9b3f2d -m 1 && ./ci/deploy staging --component quantizer
```
3) Add gating rule in nightly-eval that fails if token-stability overlap increases > 3% vs baseline, and block merge to main if nightly fails two runs in a row. Update command:
```bash
# update gating config (example)
jq '.gates += [{"name":"token-stability","metric":"token_overlap","threshold":0.03,"window":2}]' infra/eval/gates.json > /tmp/gates.json && mv /tmp/gates.json infra/eval/gates.json
```

sam (eng-infra): I'll schedule the pin and the staging revert now. Rolling hosted canary hold as well.

maria (eng-ml): medium-term actions:
- modify pack_fuse_v2 to preserve explicit delimiter tokens (PR drafted, needs review). Key change: when merging subtokens, keep a synthetic delimiter token id (e.g., DELIM_FUSED=3001) that downstream reconstruction handles correctly.
- add token-level unit tests and fuzzing harness for newline/codelblock boundaries (new failing prompt set added to regression suite).
- extend nightly-eval to include codeblock-aware metrics (preserve exact newlines inside fenced blocks).

alex (eng-ml): long-term: make quant packing opt-in per workload; don't automatically enable optimistic fusion for code-heavy promptsets. Also add a canary rollout policy: 0->10->50->100 with quality gates at each stage.

maria (eng-ml): owner assignments:
- rollback/pin: sam (eng-infra) — in progress
- staging revert & hotfix PR: cheng (eng-ml) — PR #4138
- gating rule + eval changes: eva (eng-ml) — drafting tests
- long-term plan + docs: alex (eng-ml)

cheng (eng-ml): PR #4138 opened: "pack_fuse_v2: preserve delimiter tokens for newline boundaries". Added unit tests for fenced codeblocks. Requesting review @maria @eva.

maria (eng-ml): after pin is live and staging revert deployed, we should run a full nightly with the pre-fuse variant and confirm metrics. If green, merge a temporary policy: no pack_fuse merges without passing new token-stability gate.

deploy-bot: model pin applied to nightly jobs at 2026-06-03T04:12:40Z by sam.

sam (eng-infra): pinned and blocked canary rollouts against q2-packed-fuse. Also propagated an alert to releases channel.

eva (eng-ml): I'll add the new promptset to the regression suite and wire the token-stability gate into CI. ETA EOD tomorrow for a first CI pass.

maria (eng-ml): estimated timeline:
- immediate rollback/pin: done by EOD (in progress)
- staging hotfix PR review + e2e tests: 24-48h
- gated canary policy + metric-based rollout: 1 week

alex (eng-ml): can we add a quick smoke canary that checks codeblocks on any new quant change before merging? Maybe run a small containerized evaluator that runs the 50 worst-case prompts.

maria (eng-ml): yea. we have a tiny harness already: infra/eval/smoke_codeblock.sh. Will wire that as a required check for quantizer PRs.

cheng (eng-ml): notes added to the PR and to the incident checklist. Also capturing artifacts in the nightly-eval incident ticket.

maria (eng-ml): thanks all. Will follow up with a short postmortem once PR merges and nightly is green. :white_check_mark:

alex (eng-ml): :thumbsup: keep me posted if you want help with the gating rule tests.

maria (eng-ml): closing loop: staging hotfix merged at 2026-06-03T10:22Z; nightly run with pinned variant passed token-stability checks at 2026-06-03T23:55Z. Leaving this thread open for any followups.
